requests.subject: URGENT: Legal request for debit freeze on account 123456789012 - FIR No. FIR-119/2026
requests.body:
To,
The Nodal Officer / Compliance Cell,
State Bank of India.

Subject: Directives for immediate debit freeze of Bank Account 123456789012 under Section Section.

Sir/Madam,

It is reported that this unit is currently investigating a cyber crime case registered under Case/FIR Number: FIR-119/2026 at Cyber Police Station Cyber Crime Unit, Varanasi.

During the course of the investigation, it has been established that the stolen/fraudulent funds of the crime were routed into the following account maintained with your institution:
- Account Holder Name: Rahul Verma
- Account Number: 123456789012

Additional Fraud Coordinates:
Request bank statement history for 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-28, debit reference details, and linked beneficiary account metadata.

Therefore, in exercise of powers conferred under Section Section, you are hereby directed to:
1. Immediately place a debit freeze on the aforementioned account.
2. Restrict all outward channels (Internet Banking, UPI, ATM, POS).
3. Furnish the current balance, account opening form (AOF), KYC documents, registered mobile number, and transaction logs from the inception till date.

Please acknowledge receipt and confirm compliance by replying to this email.

Regards,

Prankit
Police Inspector
Cyber Crime Unit, Varanasi
Email: sadhnil1998@gmail.com | Contact: 9695732481

HDFC Bank Nodal Fraud Control Cell (Bank / Payment Gateway / Exchange)

DSP A. R. Joshi
Economic Offences Wing (EOW), Financial Crime Unit

Account Holder Name: Vanguard Logistics (Layer-1 Transfer Account)
IFSC / Gateway Ref: [IFSC_OR_REF]

DSP A. R. Joshi
Economic Offences Wing (EOW), Financial Crime Unit
